verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API platform, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer natural-language operation (for example an AI assistant or an agent integration), so the axis applies. The evidence covers only a conventional REST API authenticated with mTLS, a dashboard, webhooks, a sandbox and a React Connect component. Nothing shows natural-language commands, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404.
